global.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
global.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
global.titleKo: MS "AI 에이전트는 내부자 위협과 같다… 프런티어 모델은 신뢰할 수 없어"
global.summaryKo: 마이크로소프트는 기업들이 직원이 OpenAI·Anthropic 등 외부 AI 연구소 시스템과 함께 쓰는 에이전트를 면밀히 감시해야 한다고 밝혔다.
global.summaryEn: Microsoft says enterprises should closely monitor the AI agents employees use with systems outside their control, such as those from OpenAI and Anthropic.

global.title: OpenAI Engineer Accused of Spying on Executives Ordered to Remain in Custody

global.summaryKo: 법원은 전 OpenAI 엔지니어 압둘라흐만 알포잔의 구금 유지를 명령하며, 석방을 보장하겠다는 사우디 정부의 제안을 '백지수표'에 비유했다.
global.summaryEn: A judge ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan to remain in custody, likening the Saudi government's offer to secure his release to a "blank check."
